name: jobapptracker
description: Job application tracker - dev task runner for the whole stack

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta -k "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it jobtracker-postgres psql -U jobtracker -d jobtracker
scripts.build: mvn -f api/pom.xml package && npm --prefix web run build
